paragraphs: "Those who study before the Sages" (lamdin lifnei ḥakhamim).
This is Levi [studying] from Rabbi, Sanhedrin 17b; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading is a plural descriptive phrase, not a personal name. מרבי means from Rabbi; “[studying]” supplies the understood relationship. No Bar Sisi identification is added.

יז: gives Sanhedrin 17b. The named William Davidson vocalized text reads “לְמֵידִין לִפְנֵי חֲכָמִים – לֵוִי מֵרַבִּי,” supporting the phrase and Levi learning from Rabbi. This digital witness does not verify Hyman’s printed page.
